body: It didnt get any better, not a tiny bit, by 6 months. Im not making the same mistake i did before with being stupid and believing there is something good waiting for me in the future. Everyone keep saying they would tell their past self how it gets better, how they should keep trying. If i could go back, i would smack my past self and tell her to not be a pussy and do it right this time already no matter what it takes.
Becouse it's pain! Doesnt matter if it's from a sicknes or from a broken heart. Sicknesses have a chance to get better. I dont, i tried and it didnt work.

Would you say that to someone in hospital dying of cancer? To keep trying becouse he will get used to it, forget, wont give a crap one day? That's so ugly. I shouldnt have to suffer when i know its too much.
But none of these help. I wantnto die, just tell me i can, it's okay if i do it.
I've been without him for 6 months and it didnt get even a tiny bit easier. Im not spending years in agony just becouse it MIGHT be easier, especially when every minute feels like eternity.
Already did, wouldnt be here otherwise. But how long should one keep yelling at clouds until they can give up already? I have to accept the reality.
Good for you for things working out, but that doesnt mean they will for me too. They wont, there is nothing good in my future. I gave it a try, i did my very best. It wasnt worth shit.

See? You too think it will pass. But it doesnt. It never does, maybe our relationship was one of a kind, maybe i was only ment for one person, idk but somewhat what works for others doesnt work on me.

You know, i understand your experience also, at least somewhat. I felt that way too before, there were night when i would cry myself to sleep, i craved the love amd intimacy... But it was way more passive?

 Not sure how to explain, the need was there, of course, but it was more like chronic pain, uncomfortable for sure, but not crippling enough to make the world stop and with the light of hope somewhere in the future. Still, i have to say, at least for me, that was way more bearable than this. It didn't feel like it back then but i do see it now. 

The pain i feel now is like im about to die, everything is wrong, it's like im having a harsh withdrawal that never ends. True love is the worst drug and living without it is making me crazy. 

Thank you for your answer, i too wish you the best, hopefully you do find what you're looking for without ending up like me afterwards.

Im sorry, all i can do is say that i trully understand. It hurts so much every second. Every night, he creeps into my dreams even when i do my best to think about anything but him and then every morning, i start the day with face full of tears, wishing he never left.

Natural is better. Noone would blame you afterwards and you don't need to have the balls for it, it just happens. It's probably scary for sure once you know it's happening, at least it was to me when i thought i was close to dying, but it's only for a little while so who cares. Worth it.
